title: Giggle
summary: GIG'GLE, noun A kind of laugh, with short catches of the voice or breath. GIG'GLE, verb intransitive To laugh with short catches of the breath or voice; to laugh in a silly, puerile manner; to titter;

inlines.v: GIG'GLE, noun A kind of laugh, with short catches of the voice or breath. GIG'GLE, verb intransitive To laugh with short catches of the breath or voice; to laugh in a silly, puerile manner; to titter; to grin with childish levity or mirth.
